partnershipPlan: Two people with lived experience of outpatient depression treatment review the questions and the summary; clinic managers review the strategy categories.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I stopped filling it in when nobody ever mentioned it.
items.implication: Clinician review, not completion, is the outcome that matters.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I have twenty minutes; if the score is not in front of me when they sit down, I will not look for it.
items.implication: Extract whether scores were available at the start of the visit.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: My phone is old and the link never opened.
items.implication: Extract completion by device access and age.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We need to know whether it will still work in two years, not just in the pilot.

summary: Four composite voices on being heard, time, device access and durability.
